ficha.rata.metafora: The rat race: working relentlessly just to pay the bills.
ficha.taza.metafora: A play on words in Spanish between «taza» (cup) and «tasa» (interest rate), plus the coffee of business meetings.
ficha.toro.metafora: The bull market: prices are rising.
ficha.oso.metafora: The bear market: prices are falling.
ficha.burbuja.metafora: The housing bubble: everything rises… until it bursts.
ficha.vaca-lechera.metafora: The dependable venture that yields steady cash every month.
ficha.elefante-blanco.metafora: The exorbitantly expensive megaproject that serves no real purpose.
ficha.hormiga.metafora: Nibble expenses: small costs that add up to a fortune.
ficha.cisne-negro.metafora: The unforeseen shock that nobody saw coming.
habilidad.horas-extra.texto: Collects {sueldo:dinero} in salary upon passing Start.
habilidad.esprint.texto: Before rolling: adds a third die to the roll. Doubles only count on the first two. Cannot be used in the Lockup.
habilidad.interes-a-favor.texto: Upon passing Start, the bank pays {porcentaje:pct} of cash on hand, up to {maximo:dinero}.
habilidad.prestamo-expres.texto: Borrow up to {maximo:dinero} from the bank. After {turnos} turns, the borrowed amount plus {interes:pct} interest is collected. While owed, the debt is deducted from net worth.
habilidad.rally.texto: Choose a district: until next turn, its share price rises by {factor:extra} for all players.
habilidad.apuesta-bajista.texto: Collects {cantidad:dinero} from the bank whenever another player mortgages a property or sells a building.
habilidad.hibernar.texto: Before rolling: pays no rent until next turn, but own properties do not collect either.
habilidad.valor-inflado.texto: For the goal only: own streets count for {factor:extra} more of their price.
habilidad.inflar.texto: An unmortgaged street multiplies rent by {factor} until next turn. It then bursts and for one round collects {factorEstallido:menos} less rent.
habilidad.renta-fija.texto: At the start of each turn, collects {porcentaje:pct} of the value of own streets and buildings, up to {maximo:dinero}.
habilidad.temporada-alta.texto: Until next turn, all collected rents rise by {factor:extra}.
habilidad.constructora.texto: Builds houses and towers with a {descuento:pct} discount.
habilidad.obras-eternas.texto: Places roadworks on another player's street: it collects no rent until the end of its owner's next turn.
habilidad.peaje-hormiga.texto: Anyone passing through an owned street without landing pays {peaje:dinero}, up to {maximoRonda:dinero} per round. Never leaves anyone in debt.
habilidad.hormiguero.texto: Until next turn, the toll rises to {peaje:dinero} per street, with no round limit.
habilidad.cazador-de-gangas.texto: In auctions, can match the highest bid and wins ties.
habilidad.frenesi.texto: Marks an opponent: the next time they land on an unowned property they cannot buy it and it is auctioned.
habilidad.antifragil.texto: On cards paying the bank, only pays {paga:pct}. On cards collecting from the bank, collects multiplied by {cobra}.
habilidad.imprevisto.texto: The chosen opponent loses their next turn.
carta.n-llega-empresa: A major company sets up in {barrio}: the district is worth {cantidad:dinero} more.
carta.n-cierra-fabrica: A factory closes in {barrio}: the district is worth {cantidad:dinero} less.
carta.n-panico: Panic on the Stock Exchange: all districts lose {porcentaje:pct} of their value.
carta.n-euforia: Market euphoria: all districts gain {porcentaje:pct} in value.
carta.n-reparto: Extraordinary dividend: each shareholder collects {porAccion:dinero} per share.
carta.n-fachadas: Facade inspection: each owner pays {casa:dinero} per house and {torre:dinero} per tower.
carta.n-desvio: Detour due to roadworks: move back {casillas} spaces.
carta.n-nueva-linea: A new line opens: advance to Central Metro.
carta.n-feria-inversores: Investors fair: advance to the Stock Exchange.
carta.n-cumbre: Economic summit in the district: advance to Capital Avenue.
carta.n-loteria: City lottery: the player with the lowest net worth collects {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.n-suben-tipos: Interest rates rise: pay {cantidad:dinero} for each mortgaged property you own.
carta.n-tasa-municipal: New municipal cleaning tax: all players pay {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-deposito: An overlooked deposit is returned to you: collect {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-herencia: Inheritance from a distant aunt: collect {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-mercadillo: You sell old items at the flea market: collect {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-concurso: You win an ideas competition: collect {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-taller: Car repair bill at the garage: pay {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-cumpleanos: It is your birthday: each player gives you {cantidad:dinero}.
carta.f-cena: You treat everyone to dinner: pay {cantidad:dinero} to each player.
carta.f-en-coche: You catch a ride: advance to the nearest transport.
carta.f-sin-conexion: You lose your connection: advance to the nearest service.
carta.f-inspeccion: Surprise inspection: go to the Lockup.
carta.f-salvoconducto: Safe-conduct: get out of the Lockup for free. Keep it until needed, or sell it.
carta.f-soplo: A market tip: buy {cantidad} shares of {barrio} at half price.
carta.f-goteras: Leaks in your buildings: pay {casa:dinero} per house and {torre:dinero} per tower.
carta.f-paseo: Stroll along the lookout: advance to Star Street.
carta.f-llaves: You forgot your keys: move back {casillas} spaces.
